basic_info.description: Built in 1920 & offered for the 1st time in nearly 80 years, this beautifully maintained traditional home is a rare treasure in San Francisco's prestigious Forest Hill neighborhood. Set on a flat, tree-lined block of Magellan, this home offers a bright, inviting floor plan perfect for entertaining. Gracious entry hall leads into formal living room w/built-in bookcases & wood-burning fireplace. Spacious formal dining room is ideal for large family gatherings. Kitchen has vintage charm & features new stone counters & walk-in pantry. Convenient, versatile en-suite guest room/home office provides flexibility for today's lifestyle. Welcoming family room with fireplace & beamed ceilings opens directly to walk-out garden, a beautifully landscaped outdoor space w/lawn & planting beds. Upstairs, the sunlit primary suite has private full bath & walk-in closet, while 2 additional bedrooms share full bath off hall. Bright sunroom/office opens onto a large rooftop deck. Addtl features include 2-car tandem parking, generous storage space, & potential for dedicated laundry in garage. Ideal location close to West Portal's shops, cafes, restaurants, 2 Muni Metro stations, playgrounds, parks, major freeways and access to the historic Maybeck Clubhouse, a beloved neighborhood landmark.
